name: web
description: Q-Summit website: Astro static site (see ADR-0001).

scripts.check: astro check && tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/visual/tsconfig.json
scripts.vrt:update: pnpm run vrt:build && playwright test --update-snapshots && node ../../scripts/check/vrt-report.mjs --prune-only --trust-gallery
scripts.vrt:docker: docker run --rm -e CI=1 -e HOME=/tmp -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD/../..":/w -w /w/apps/web mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble bash -lc 'export PATH=/tmp/bin:$PATH; mkdir -p /tmp/bin && corepack enable --install-directory /tmp/bin pnpm && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir=/w/node_modules/.pnpm-store && pnpm run vrt'
scripts.vrt:docker:update: docker run --rm -e CI=1 -e HOME=/tmp -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD/../..":/w -w /w/apps/web mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble bash -lc 'export PATH=/tmp/bin:$PATH; mkdir -p /tmp/bin && corepack enable --install-directory /tmp/bin pnpm && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir=/w/node_modules/.pnpm-store && pnpm run vrt:update'
